turns.text: Morning! I just moved into a flat in Leeds near the canal and I am still unpacking boxes.
Congratulations on the move. Want a checklist for the first week?
Yes please. Also the name of our cat is Biscuit, and she hides under the sofa all day.
Cats often hide after a move. Give her a quiet corner with a blanket.
I work as a translator, mostly legal contracts from Portuguese.
Legal translation needs steady focus, so plan short breaks.
Remind me to buy curtains this weekend.
Noted: curtains this weekend.
Big news: we relocated again, and the city I live in now is Porto, by the river.
The riverside sounds lovely. How is the new place?
Can you pull my calendar so I can see this month at a glance?
Your month looks calm, with three events on the list.
Thanks, I will set a reminder the day before.

turns.text: I finished my last shift as a nurse on the night ward and I am exhausted.
Rest first. Night shifts take a few days to recover from.
The name of my dog is Pepper, and he loves chasing gulls on the beach.
Pepper sounds like great company on a slow morning.
I want to cook a lentil soup tonight with whatever is in the fridge.
Lentils, an onion and stock will do. Simmer for twenty minutes.
Remind me to call my brother on Sunday.
Update: I retrained and my job now is paramedic with the coastal ambulance team.
That is a big change. How was the first week on the ambulance?
Busy but good. The radio codes took a while to learn.
They come quickly with practice.
Pepper is staying with my neighbour while I work long shifts.
Good plan for the long shifts.
I booked a haircut for Saturday.
